cohort: 1067 nulligravida women with singleton term pregnancies who gave birth at King Abdulaziz University Hospital (KAUH), Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, between January 2016 to December 2017
finding: While there was no association found between maternal height and vaginal delivery, there was a significant negative association between maternal height and cesarean section delivery.
mod_finding: There was a significant negative association between maternal height and cesarean section delivery.
gest_age: Term pregnancies; most women were at 40 weeks of gestation
birth_weight: Measured; for every 1 cm increase in women's height, the baby's weight increases by 12.8 gms
